notes.title: Millia -The ending- will be a free game
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
It's been 2 years since we released our game. There has been a lot going on in our part. We couldn't manage to get a permission to sell our game locally in our country, and we're not doing great on Steam either. As a result, we think that it would be best to make our game free on Steam, so that anyone who takes an interest in our game can play it for free. There will be a prequel coming our way, and it will be free as well. When we're ready to release the prequel, we will post another announcement here on Steam.
 
Thank you all for supporting us!

notes.title: An important update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I'm the leader of the group Millia Soft.

When you log in your Steam, you will find that our game has an update. After you download the update, you will see the background music of the main menu screen has been changed and the opening movie's music (which is also the song on main menu screen) has also been changed. 
This is an unexpected incident for me.

When I showed my friend this game, he realized that the song on the main menu has many parts that sound very similar to a song named "Carrying you" from an old anime of studio Ghibli. After I heard that, I immediately checked and it turned out to be true. I talked to the composer and he said that he made the song by himself, not stealing from anyone. Maybe he heard the heard the other song from the past and its melody was stuck in his head so he got influenced and unconsciously made a new song based on that melody. It's just a guess, I don't know about that. 
I don't want to doubt anyone, but it won’t serve as answer for anyone who finds out the similarity of the two songs, especially not the law.
That's why I took down the old music video and replaced it with a new one.
It's my fault as a bad leader that something like this happened. I'm sorry.
I also fixed many errors such as typo and grammars, I hope it makes the game become better.

Thank you all for supporting!
